title: Field-Based Wound Care Protocol
implementation_guidance: Implement a field-based wound care protocol for unsheltered individuals that includes: 1) Carrying a specialized wound care kit with sterile supplies, antimicrobial solutions, and various dressing materials; 2) Conducting systematic wound assessment using the standardized HEIDI mnemonic (History, Examination, Infection, Depth, Ischemia); 3) Providing appropriate cleaning and dressing based on wound type and available resources; 4) Creating a realistic follow-up schedule based on wound severity and patient mobility; 5) Documenting wound characteristics with photographs when possible (with patient consent); and 6) Developing clear criteria for emergency department referral. The protocol should emphasize practical approaches that account for limited access to running water, clean environments, and regular dressing changes.
expected_outcomes: Improved wound healing rates, reduced wound-related complications, decreased emergency department utilization for preventable wound complications, and increased patient knowledge of basic wound self-care.
target_population: Unsheltered individuals with acute or chronic wounds, particularly those with limited access to traditional healthcare settings
citation: Raven MC, et al. Mobile health and outreach services for persons experiencing homelessness: a systematic review. J Gen Intern Med. 2023;38(3):712-721. doi:10.1007/s11606-022-07707-x
